negative_snippets:
Third class rooms, pathetic service. All the rooms smell strongly of cigarettes, they don't have any non-smoking rooms. Bedsheets were dirty and torn. No towel provided. Bathroom was not clean.
The phone inside the room was not working, so there's no way to reach out to the reception.

Avoid this place, unless you absolutely love to have bad experiences!

Very poor experience. The room was not okay, bedsheet was not changed, no toilet paper, no basic items in the room. Even mineral water was charged ₹30. Washroom was not clean and service was missing. They charge too much but give nothing in return. I feel many of the good reviews here might be fake, because my experience was completely different
